title: The Testability Gap: A Pre-Registered Census of Naming versus Implementation in 59 Cognitive-Architecture LLM Systems
title_zh: 可测试性鸿沟：对 59 个认知架构 LLM 系统中命名与实现关系的预注册普查

paragraphs.en: 预注册普查59个认知架构LLM系统，发现可测试性鸿沟：85.5%的悬空引用是从未存在的幽灵路径。 A companion line of work audited individual cognitive-architecture LLM systems in depth and found that module names and module computations are empirically independent claims. This paper asks how far that gap extends across the system class. We pre-registered a census protocol (sample frame, metrics, and acceptance criteria frozen before any sample was downloaded) and surveyed the 59 most-starred Python repositories declaring cognitive architecture on GitHub, plus five classic architectures as a historical control. We measure a testability gap. First, an auditability gap: 22% of repositories document no code reference whatsoever. Second, an integrity gap: 42% of repositories have at least one dangling reference, and within that subgroup the median fraction is 8%, the top quartile 19.6%, and the maximum 79.5%; one 148-star system documents paths of which a majority do not exist. Three of four pre-registered hypotheses were falsified: the integrity gap is not universal (58% of repositories either offer no checkable references or offer references that all resolve); claim density does not predict dangling rate (rho = -0.10); and the classical-architecture control does not significantly outperform (p = 0.059 with five controls, all at zero dangling). Exactly one repository in 59 (1.7%) ships executable falsification criteria for its own claims. A second pre-registered round classified every dangling path by git lifetime: 85.5% of dangling references (159 of 186) are ghosts - paths that never existed at any commit - against 14.5% that were once real and later removed.
paragraphs.zh: 预注册普查59个认知架构LLM系统，发现可测试性鸿沟：85.5%的悬空引用是从未存在的幽灵路径。另一条并行的工作线深入审计了个别认知架构LLM系统，发现模块名称与模块计算在经验上是相互独立的主张。 本文追问这一鸿沟在整个系统类别中延伸到何种程度。 我们预注册了一套普查方案（样本框架、指标与验收标准在任何样本下载之前即已冻结），并调查了GitHub上声称认知架构的星标数最高的59个Python仓库，外加五个经典架构作为历史对照。 我们测得一个可测试性鸿沟。 其一，可审计性鸿沟：22%的仓库未记录任何代码引用。 其二，完整性鸿沟：42%的仓库至少有一条悬空引用，在该子群中中位数比例为8%，上四分位为19.6%，最大值达79.5%；一个148星的系统所记录的路径中多数并不存在。 四个预注册假设中有三个被证伪：完整性鸿沟并非普遍存在（58%的仓库要么不提供可核查的引用，要么所提供的引用全部可解析）；主张密度不能预测悬空率（rho = -0.10）；经典架构对照并未显著表现更优（p = 0.059，五个对照的悬空数均为零）。 59个仓库中恰好只有一个（1.7%）为其自身主张提供了可执行的证伪标准。 第二轮预注册分析按git生命周期对每条悬空路径进行了分类：85.5%的悬空引用（186条中的159条）是幽灵——即在任何提交中都从未存在过的路径——相比之下，14.5%曾是真实路径但后来被移除。
